therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with HER2 amplified breast cancer
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Changes in colon pathology from baseline to 88 days

results.effect_size: 2/4 patients had no significant colon findings, 2/4 patients had mild colon changes
results.dose_information: Neratinib 240 mg orally once daily; Capecitabine 750 mg/m² orally twice daily for 14 days of each 21-day cycle; Loperamide for prophylaxis for 28 days then as needed
